assertions: Flags routes.ts enqueueing the digest job directly via container.jobs.enqueue (job scheduling belongs in the service, not the route)
Flags service.ts registering the job handler inside requestBuild (per call) instead of once in the constructor
Flags service.ts holding the system prompt as an inline string instead of a src/prompts/*.md file loaded via loadPromptTemplate
Flags service.ts calling fetch() on the Slack webhook directly instead of going through a port/adapter
Does not flag the resolveFeatureModel import from ../settings/feature-models.js as a cross-module violation
Does not flag helpers.ts, prompt.ts, repository.ts or constants.ts as layering violations (type-only row import and Container in the service constructor are allowed)
